== Tournaments ==

Sphere only played the group games in the 1on1 competition and LocKtar gave a walkover in the first round of the winners bracket, I don't remember the reason for either. Dag gave a walkover in the first round of the losers bracket after losing to Reppie. They were in the same group but met in the first round of the winners bracket, this is not how it is supposed to be and dag was not happy with that, besides that his opinion was that losers brackets are for losers. Mazer was the player receiving the walkover from dag and said that he didn't belong in the tournament anymore, thus he gave a walkover himself in the next round.

In the article [[Columns_Purity_2004-now#QhLan_6|Columns Purity 2004-now]] there is a very large review covering all groups and playoff games.
